City of Sterling
Referred Ballot Issue 2A
AUTHORIZATION TO INCREASE CITY SALES AND
USE TAX FOR STREET AND ROAD
IMPROVEMENTS
SHALL THE CITY OF STERLING TAXES BE
INCREASED $3,600,000 ANNUALLY, BEGINNING
JANUARY 1, 2027, AND BY SUCH AMOUNTS AS
ARE COLLECTED ANNUALLY THEREAFTER FOR A
PERIOD OF FIVE (5) YEARS, BY THE IMPOSITION
OF AN ADDITIONAL TEMPORARY 1.0% CITY
SALES AND USE TAX, IN ORDER TO INCREASE OR
IMPROVE PUBLIC SERVICES INCLUDING STREET
AND ROAD IMPROVEMENTS AND RELATED
MAINTENANCE NEEDS; AND SHALL THE
REVENUES FROM SUCH TAX:
BE DEPOSITED INTO A DEDICATED FUND
SEPARATE FROM THE CITY'S GENERAL FUND
AND USED SOLELY FOR THE PURPOSE OF
REPAVING, REPAIRING, MAINTAINING, AND
IMPROVING CITY STREETS AND ROADS,
INCLUDING RELATED IMPROVEMENTS SUCH AS
DRAINAGE, CURBS AND GUTTERS, AND
PEDESTRIAN SAFETY IMPROVEMENTS; AND
SHALL THE CITY BE AUTHORIZED TO COLLECT,
RETAIN, AND SPEND ALL REVENUES GENERATED
BY SUCH TAX, TOGETHER WITH ANY EARNINGS
THEREON, WITHOUT LIMITATION OR CONDITION,
AS A VOTER-APPROVED REVENUE CHANGE
PURSUANT TO ARTICLE X, SECTION 20 OF THE
COLORADO CONSTITUTION, OR ANY OTHER LAW?

Buffalo School District RE-4J
Referred Ballot Issue 5A
WITHOUT IMPOSING A NEW TAX, SHALL BUFFALO
SCHOOL DISTRICT RE-4J DEBT BE INCREASED
$1.25 MILLION, WITH A TOTAL REPAYMENT COST
OF UP TO $1.7 MILLION, AND SHALL DISTRICT
TAXES AUTHORIZED IN 2007 BE EXTENDED TO
PAY SUCH NEW DEBT INCURRED FOR THE
PURPOSE OF FINANCING THE COSTS OF:
UPGRADING AND ENHANCING SECURITY
·
AND SAFETY FEATURES, INCLUDING THE
INSTALLATION OF NEW CAMERA AND KEY
FOB ACCESS SYSTEMS;
CONSTRUCTING IMPROVEMENTS TO THE
·
MAIN ENTRANCES OF THE ELEMENTARY
AND HIGH SCHOOL BUILDINGS; AND
IMPROVING THE DISTRICT'S ELEMENTARY
·
PLAYGROUND, INCLUDING THE
INSTALLATION OF SAFER FLOORING AND
OTHER UPGRADES;
AND TO THE EXTENT OF AVAILABLE FUNDS,
REFINANCING THE DISTRICT'S EXISTING CAPITAL
LEASE, BY THE ISSUANCE AND PAYMENT OF
GENERAL OBLIGATION BONDS WHICH SHALL
BEAR INTEREST, MATURE, BE SUBJECT TO
REDEMPTION, WITH OR WITHOUT PREMIUM, AND
BE ISSUED AT SUCH TIME, AT SUCH PRICE (AT,
ABOVE OR BELOW PAR) AND IN SUCH MANNER
AND CONTAINING SUCH TERMS CONSISTENT
WITH THIS BALLOT ISSUE, AS THE BOARD OF
EDUCATION MAY DETERMINE; AND SHALL AD
VALOREM PROPERTY TAXES BE LEVIED
WITHOUT LIMIT AS TO THE MILL RATE TO
GENERATE AMOUNTS, NOT TO EXCEED $200,000
ANNUALLY, SUFFICIENT IN EACH YEAR TO PAY
THE PRINCIPAL OF, PREMIUM IF ANY, AND
INTEREST ON THE BONDS?
